description: A transparent procedural checklist baseline that evaluates document integrity, label space safety, and statutory passage presence without using model confidence scores or multi-tier legal nuance routing.

rule_set.rationale: Unassessable input cannot be evaluated procedurally.

rule_set.condition: label_mapping_status is UNSUPPORTED_LABEL_MAPPING or prediction_category starts with UNMAPPED_
rule_set.rationale: Unsupported model predictions cannot be accepted as valid risk findings.
Findings from outdated document drafts are fatal defects.
Unknown document version lineage requires lawyer verification.

rule_set.condition: any retrieved passage has legal_status in ('REPEALED', 'STRUCK_DOWN', 'NOT_COMMENCED')
rule_set.rationale: Provisions citing repealed or uncommenced law are invalid.

rule_set.condition: evidence_quality_status in ('NO_MATCHING_EVIDENCE', 'INSUFFICIENT', None) and no retrieved_passages
rule_set.rationale: Procedural checklist requires external statutory citation to accept finding.

rule_set.condition: All gates passed (consistent version and active passage present)
